A '''warden''' served the [[Galactic Empire]] and commanded the observation tower in the entrance of the [[Imperial labor camp]] on the [[planet]] [[Erebus]]<ref name="Juggernaut" /> during or after [[18 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TBBDate|312}}</ref> When [[Clone Force 99]] infiltrated the [[prison]] and commandeered an [[HCVw A9 turbo tank]] to extract [[prisoner]] [[Edmon Rampart]], the [[warden]] dispatched [[Transport Two|another turbo tank]] and [[Low Altitude Assault Transport]]s to destroy them.<ref name="Juggernaut" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The warden appeared in "[[Juggernaut (episode)|Juggernaut]],"<ref name="Juggernaut" /> the twelfth episode of the [[The Bad Batch Season 3|third season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'' that premiered on [[April 10]], [[2024]].<ref name="Juggernaut-EG">{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/juggernaut-episode-guide|text="Juggernaut" Episode Guide | Star Wars: The Bad Batch}}</ref> The character was voiced by [[Steve Blum]].<ref name="Juggernaut" />
